help.short: The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.
The name of local user. The username must contain lowercase letters and numbers only. It must be unique only within the storage account.

confirmation: Are you sure you want to perform this operation?
description: Delete the local user associated with the specified storage account.

operations.description: Deletes the local user associated with the specified storage account.

params.description: The name of the storage account within the specified resource group. Storage account names must be between 3 and 24 characters in length and use numbers and lower-case letters only.
params.name: accountName

params.description: The name of the resource group within the user's subscription. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

params.description: The name of local user. The username must contain lowercase letters and numbers only. It must be unique only within the storage account.
params.name: username

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

responses.description: OK -- Delete the local user successfully.
